summary:
I am an experienced and self-driven Sales Manager with over 15+ years of industry expertise, specializing in overseeing
sales performance and developing new accounts. I have a strong track record of collaborating effectively with sales teams
to meet objectives, drive revenue growth, and streamline the sales cycle.
I am a dedicated contributor with a proven ability to boost sales and devise strategies for customer retention. Throughout
my career, I have developed my communication skills and demonstrated a talent for building strong relationships. My
passion lies in working closely with businesses to deliver exceptional service.
I hold an MBA in Marketing from SCMLD, Pune, which I completed in 2010.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(Strategic Planning→Strategic Thinking(100%), collaborating→Collaboration(92%), teams→Microsoft Teams(100%), objectives→Objective C(90%))

bullets: Managing and expanding the uPVC doors and windows hardware sales at VEKA Pvt.
Ltd., with responsibility for business growth and operations across West Region — Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, and Chhattisgarh.
My role involves analyzing business potential and conceptualizing strategies to drive vertical growth across these regions.
I have contributed to increasing turnover and achieving targets by effectively managing fabricators and ensuring adherence to agreed parameters.
Expanded the fabricator network from 60 to 120 partners, strengthening regional market presence and sales reach.
My responsibilities include identifying and pursuing business opportunities through market surveys, mapping, and lead generation aligned with targeted plans.
In addition, I develop and execute comprehensive business plans for each region under my purview.
I also analyze regional market trends to uncover new growth opportunities.
Regularly, I prepare monthly and quarterly sales reports, presenting my findings and analysis to senior management during review meetings.

To analyze business potential, conceptualize & execute strategies to drive vertical growth, increase turnover and achieve the targets thereby as per the parameters agreed; through dealers / trade management.
Identify and pursue business opportunities through market surveys and mapping as per targeted plans as well as through lead generation.
To work closely with trade network, its expansion, dealer development and extract business through them, which will uplift the Value Added or premium segment product sale.
Target for Specification and Conversion into Sales .
Grow project pipeline by working closely with Architects / Contractors / Developers Develop and drive marketing activities relevant for increasing business revenue in the area.

Initiating strategic partnership with Local Fabricator, Turnkey Contractor, Interior Designers and Builders Accountable for handling brand promotion through Builder Meets Architects Meet and ID meets.
Identify Builders who are not specifying different Vertical Products as per their CBS potential Mapping and converting them to give us sustain CBS Business.
Making & giving the presentations to Builders/Architects about CBS verticals.
Ensure service camps & training to team are organized as per agreed schedule of Projects for our products.
Ensure proactive customer care services to organized at all four stages of all projects.
To ensure that the Builders are properly followed from first meeting till maturity & ensure targeted conversion of builders into sales.
To brief builders and their sales staff about complete range of bathing solution products, concept selling rather than doing product selling.

To educate project key decision makers on range of complete bathing solution products , its purpose & features To ensure Mock-ups in the initial stages of the project and subsequently secure the orders To follow up with key account project who patronize respective dealer counters and educate them on complete bathing solution products, products details, our USPs, competition benchmarking and generate leads from them
